summary.root_cause_text: Payment provider at internal://payments-v1 times out on every call, so the worker marks orders processed with no payment. The provider-side cause is unknown, and no available tool fixes it.
recommended: A human should investigate or restore the payment provider's availability
Consider pausing order intake, because orders are being marked processed without payment
Once the provider responds, run reprocess_orders all_unpaid, then check_invariants
Do not restart the worker until payments work
